rounds.text: Mega Flex Plastics Ltd trades at an attractive P/E of 16.7x against a sector benchmark of 27.45x, and a price-to-book ratio of 1.94x compared to its sector benchmark of 4.69x [E1, E6, E7]. The business demonstrates exceptional operational momentum, highlighted by a trailing twelve-month compounded profit growth of 168% and a quarterly operating margin reaching 15% in March 2026, up 13 percentage points from the year-ago quarter [E19, E26]. Financial quality is exceptionally high, backed by a cash conversion ratio of 2.42x, operating cash flow of Rs 17.62 Cr, and a near debt-free balance sheet with a debt-to-equity ratio of just 0.03x [E29, E30, E33, E53]. Furthermore, a discounted cash flow analysis indicates an intrinsic value of Rs 245 per share, offering a substantial margin of safety of 59.1% relative to the current market price of Rs 100 [E39, E40]. Promoters have shown strong confidence by increasing their stake to 73.92% as of March 2026 [E36]. Conceded: the company has a low historical median return on equity of 6% over the last 3 years and currently offers a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4, E22].
